description: This file defines an administrative controller class for managing users within the Goteo project. It includes methods for listing users, managing individual user details, adding new users, handling user roles, and impersonating users. The class extends an abstract admin controller and utilizes Symfony components for routing and HTTP handling, as well as Goteo-specific models, services, and utilities.

classes.name: UsersAdminController
classes.description: Controller class for administrative user management, including listing, role management, impersonation, and user creation within the Goteo application.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Returns the route definitions for user management actions.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles displaying a paginated list of users possibly filtered by a search query.

methods.name: manageAction
methods.description: Displays detailed management interface for a specific user identified by UID.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new user via a form, processing submission, and displaying validation errors.

methods.name: rolesAction
methods.description: Displays and manages roles assigned to a user or, if no user specified, the roles of the current admin.

methods.name: impersonateAction
methods.description: Allows an admin to impersonate a user, including session switching and logging the impersonation event.
